description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a mac or linux computer. no telemetry.
Changed
- a pairing link can now point at a public IPv4 address you can reach your journal at, not only one on your local network. pairing over the internet works the same way as pairing at home: the link still carries your journal's fingerprint, and this PC still checks it before trusting anything.
